answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single hardware-verified key before it can earn: one key, one identity, and slashing if the same key signs duplicate work. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must buy a thousand keys and lock a thousand stakes, so the cost of a Sybil swarm scales linearly instead of being free. Honest agents get their stake back, like water returning to an oasis after a dry season, while the fable of costless sockpuppets collapses. A walnut is hard to crack, and so is an identity that costs real money to forge.
